Transparent economics

No value created? No commission earned.

Founding profiles are free. After 90 days and three qualified introductions, we review the results together. Paid participation is always opt-in.

5%

Discovery referral

We make the introduction. You take it from there.

10%

Qualified opportunity

15%

Concierge coordination

We qualify the request and coordinate the wider event.

The guardrails: No listing fee. No fee on customers you already own. Commission applies only to completed OAE-originated bookings under agreed terms.
